reports.notes: Completed today. 9 ft of excavation on the octagon pits. One scraper out of two broke down at 10:55am for the day. Only one remaining. Excavator starting to dig out corners of pits. No staking in place for bedding barn as of now.

One 627 Scraper/One 745 dump truck/One 336 Excavator/One 5k gallon water truck. Excavation hit sand at 12'6" depth. Lay down area located for 40' storage container and rebar delivery next Wednesday. Edgar from Mje says they will have excavation completed this Friday.

Confirming soils curve tomorrow morning. Second dump truck was canceled, Albers says it's not necessary.
He will have the pits excavated by end of Monday. Rebar is being delivered next Tuesday. Only two crew members worked from 7-9 then four crew members from 11-6:30pm. Installed 520' of caution tape around pits.

Soils samples from bottom of pits verified that the curve is still correct. Crew of four excavating pits today.
Good progress today and working tomorrow as well.
The crew worked 7-12 today and established rough grade @ 26' depth at octagon mixing pits. Excavation crew to start walls (banks) and bottom work on Monday. Rebar for concrete work is scheduled for delivery Tuesday morning.

Today the dirt crew stair stepped the octagon mixing pits at my request. They probably have 3 hours left of excavation to finish, then clean up the bottom and start compaction. Backfill/compaction will start Wednesday. Concrete crew along with rebar delivery is Wednesday. I have Ted set up to be there during the complete process of backfilling. Albers with MJE said he will have a solid six week schedule for me on Thursday. Staking for fiber barn will be completed tomorrow per Edgar.

First delivery of rebar delivered today. Corner staking for fiber barn completed today. Decided to excavate another 3' off the bottom of pits due to sugar sand. After finishing that excavation we will compact the bottom,then build back up with good soil compaction tests every 6". 25 mph wind today. Also located natural gas line being installed towards the project.

Today I had the same Four crew from MJE. 1 excavator 1 scraper 1 dump truck 1 water truck 1 grader 1 sheep foot compactor.
Ted with ATE was onsite all day for tests. I established excavation protection with caution tape again. Two more trucks delivered rebar today and I verified domestic content on all rebar.excavation of another 6' of sugar sand was finished by 11am. Started backfilling after lunch. Crew completed three 8" lifts each lift compacted down to 6". Test results: Proctor used : DD 112.7/M14.4.

Iron horse concrete showed up onsite at end of day ready to start forming work after pit staking is completed first thing tomorrow morning.

reports.notes:
Dirt crew is not working the project today for us. Luis with Iron horse concrete say his crew needs rest and will start Monday morning. Edgar to Verify points for pits with Hayden and stake early Monday morning.
Safety meeting completed with two iron horse men and Edgar with MJE. No work happening today. Edgar leaving for the weekend as well. I will be in touch with Albers today regarding updates on schedule.

No work at octagon pit today due to rain. At 8:05am rain event came through and lasted intermittently until 11am. Iron Horse concrete crew showed up on site at 8:30 for work. Edgar told them it was already far too wet for work. I haven't received updated MJE schedule from Albers as of yet, after telling me he would have it to me no later than last Thursday. BMP water diversion controls are working properly keeping discharge away from octagon pit.

Iron horse concrete co was onsite at 9:15am. Started staking octagon pits. Started setting concrete forms at 11am. Forms were in place by 1:30pm. Starting rebar work tomorrow morning. They plan to pour concrete this Saturday. Seven crew members. Elvis Argueta- Javier Lopez- Jaimie Orellano- Ignacio Galvan- Ivan Ruiz- Luis Duarte.

Today the iron horse crew was onsite at 7:30am . Crew stayed in trucks until 9am when Luis (foreman) showed up. Started working shortly after until Luis needed to confirm rebar details for slab at octagons. I had them stop work until we confirmed layout of rebar sizes and lengths needed to be used. At 11:45 Hector and Hayden agreed on some changes. Hector sent over new rebar details and the crew resumed work. Same seven crew members onsite today.

Only 5 crew men with iron horse today. Foreman and lead man weren't there today. I was also told there will be one less man tomorrow. They'll be continuing to tie rebar tomorrow morning. I spoke with Hayden today about the 12" opening he needs in the side of octagon to finish concrete. Hector approved his method. Crew started at 8am and finished work at 5pm.

Safety meeting took place at 8:15am with 5 iron horse employees. Second mat was start at 8:30am. I requested compaction testing reports from A.T.E..
Office/Conex was delivered to iron horse today. Iron horse said they would work through weekend to make next Wednesday's deadline for concrete pour. They will have a total of 8 working this weekend. Second mat was completed at 6:15pm today and will start dowel work tomorrow morning. They will also reinforce forms for slab. The 24' dowels will be supported vertically with rebar stabilizers for accurate placement at slab. 10.0 hours worked by crew.

Today iron horse concrete has 10 men working including Luis. Starting on top mat and layout of corner forms. I confirmed with Hector 135 degree corners of octagons and working to finish top mat and wire ties.
Tomorrow's plan is to finish top mat and reinforce perimeter forms. Starting dowel work tomorrow or Monday.

Today iron horse crew with 11 men worked 8.5 hours. Ryan Dewit did a site visit with family today. I verified rebar splicing at 2' overlaps. Scaffolding may be necessary to set dowel due to the length of dowels. All rebar mats are in completed now. I'm ready for Hector to confirm and give approval for concrete pour on Wednesday, providing he approves dowel system installation.

Today Hector was on site and inspected and approved all rebar placement. Crew of 10 started dowel work.
Dowel failure at 10:32am from lack of proper stabilization and 35mph wind gusts. 30 dowels fell to the ground at the same time. No injuries from this. I got approval from Hector to spice all dowels in 10' sections with 60" overlap. Rain is predicted for Wednesday and will be pouring concrete either Thursday or Friday. By end of day east octagon was completed with 10' sections. After concrete pour scaffolding will be set up to splice remaining 10' to correct elevation.

Today Iron horse crew of ten continues dowel work on west octagon. I confirmed with Terry at batch plant that he could supply pump truck and 300 yards of concrete on Thursday. Iron horse crew stopped work due to high winds for two hours today. At 2pm crew started dowel work on the inside octagon walls. All dowels should be completed by tomorrow afternoon.

Today iron horse crew arrived at site at 8:30am. There was a light drizzle at that time and at 8:50am it began raining. At 9:00am iron horse crew left site. I talked with Edgar and Hayden about it and I began trying to call Luis. Didn't answer calls or respond to voicemails I left him. Hayden also was trying to reach out to him. I went back to site at 2pm and they were back onsite working. At that point the project had received .35" of rain. They continued dowels and water stop work until end of day. I spoke with Luis in person and he stated that it was raining too much and it's too dark to start working before 8am. I told him when the crew left we had only received .20" of rain and it had stopped. I spoke with Hayden and said he was going to have a "conversation" with Luis. Hayden is having light towers delivered to octagons tomorrow. I also told Luis all other concrete crews stayed and worked throughout the project along with all others performing work onsite.
I said it was unacceptable for the crew to leave with such a small amount of rain. Told him to tighten up and keep our schedule as a top priority. He stated he will be ready to pour concrete Friday at noon.

Today iron horse crew of 10 started at 8:15am finishing dowel work and forming reinforcement. Hayden confirmed he is supplying the pvc spool for octagon. Batch plant and pump truck confirmed they are ready for 8am pour tomorrow morning. Light towers and portable toilet was delivered to site today. Iron horse cleared it with Hayden and myself they will be going home for the weekend and back working on forming and scaffolding at 8am Monday morning, providing the weather allows for work. I sent pictures to Hector earlier for review and approval to pour concrete tomorrow morning.
